turns.replyText:
To help you find the best value for money, here is a comparison of our two flagship options: the Hybrid Mattress and the Hybrid Premium Mattress.

The Hybrid Mattress: The Essentials at a Fair Price

This is our most accessible option that makes no compromises on quality.

Thickness: 25 cm.
Comfort: Medium-firm, ideal for balanced support.
Structure: 7 comfort layers including pocket springs for excellent motion isolation.
Highlights: Excellent back support and a structure reinforced with a support casing, ensuring the edges do not sag.
Price: Starting from €289.90.
The Hybrid Premium Mattress: Superior and Customizable Comfort

It offers a more upscale experience with unique personalization.

Thickness: 27 cm (more foam for a more generous feel).
Comfort: Balanced and reversible. You can choose between a firm side or a soft side depending on your preferences.
Structure: 8 comfort layers with a higher spring density for even more precise support.
Highlights: Optimal breathability and the ability to adapt your comfort over time without changing your mattress.
Price: Starting from €409.90.
In summary

If your budget is your top priority while you still want a durable, French-quality mattress, the Hybrid Mattress is the ideal choice.

If you can afford a slightly higher investment to benefit from reversibility and a more enveloping feel, the Hybrid Premium Mattress offers unparalleled versatility.

In both cases, you benefit from a 100-night trial to test the comfort directly in your own home! 🙂

turns.replyText:
That is a very fair question! Both mattresses are designed to last over 10 years and are made with the same high standards of French quality.

The Hybrid Mattress is more than just "fine"; it is an excellent mattress that provides firm support and great durability. If money is tight, this is truly the best "bang for your buck" because it covers all the essentials of a high-quality sleep without any unnecessary extras.

The Hybrid Premium Mattress is worth the extra investment if you are sensitive to changes in comfort needs over time. Its reversible topper (firm or soft) means you are essentially getting two comfort levels in one. It is also slightly thicker (27 cm), which provides a more plush, hotel-like feel and even more precise support for the back.

In short, if you want a reliable and comfortable mattress at the best possible price, the Hybrid Mattress is a fantastic choice. If you prefer having the flexibility to adjust your comfort level and want a bit more luxury, the Hybrid Premium is the way to go.

Keep in mind that you have 100 nights to try your choice at home. If it does not suit you perfectly, we will take it back for free! 🙂
